title: Resume a Claude Code session from New Tab (user 2026-11-20: "resuming claude sessions needs to 'just work'"): /resume <id>, a pasted id, claude -r <id>, and an unknown id; the chat's transcript is in another folder than the workspace's

steps.title: Seed: a short Claude Code transcript in ~/resume-demo
cmux: clear; mkdir -p "$HOME/resume-demo" && cd "$HOME/resume-demo" && C=$(pwd -P); S=5a7e5a7e-0000-4000-8000-000000003000; D="${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/projects/$(printf %s "$C" | tr -c "A-Za-z0-9" -)"; mkdir -p "$D" && python3 -c 'import json,sys;p,c,s=sys.argv[1:4];u=lambda i:"5a7e0000-0000-4000-9000-%012d"%i;Q=["Why does the sidebar jump when a workspace closes?","Make the close keep the scroll offset.","Add a test for it."];A=["The list rebuilds its rows, so the offset resets to the top.","Done: the sidebar keeps its offset and the row under the pointer stays put.","Added `closeKeepsOffset`, which fails before the change and passes after."];open(p,"w").write("".join(json.dumps({"type":("user","assistant")[i%2],"uuid":u(i),"parentUuid":u(i-1) if i else None,"sessionId":s,"timestamp":"2026-11-19T10:%02d:00.000Z"%i,"cwd":c,"message":{"role":"user","content":Q[i//2]} if i%2==0 else {"id":"msg_%d"%i,"type":"message","role":"assistant","model":"claude-opus-5-5","content":[{"type":"text","text":A[i//2]}],"stop_reason":"end_turn"}})+"\n" for i in range(6)))' "$D/$S.jsonl" "$C" "$S" && echo TRANSCRIPT-READY && cd "$HOME"

steps.title: Light: /resume with an id no chat has
Light: Return on the unknown id
Dark: Return resumes the chat with its history
